evidence: Tagged with Wallet label and modifies CWallet::FillPSBT, DescriptorScriptPubKeyMan, and descriptor interfaces to populate BIP 174 global xpubs.
rationale: Populating PSBT_GLOBAL_XPUB resolves confusing signing failures and interoperability issues with stateless hardware signers like BitBox02 and Trezor. The description cites hardware wallet rejections ('This BitBox02 is not one of the cosigners') and downstream workarounds in Specter Desktop, addressing long-standing issue #27583.
